Theming targets
7 across 1 component
(key - component - props - states - className)

multi-selector                  MultiSelector - variant, size, status - disabled, readonly - astryx-multi-selector
multi-selector-empty-state      MultiSelector - astryx-multi-selector-empty-state
multi-selector-indicator-icon   MultiSelector - state - astryx-multi-selector-indicator-icon
multi-selector-option           MultiSelector - size - select-all, selected, disabled - astryx-multi-selector-option
multi-selector-popup            MultiSelector - astryx-multi-selector-popup
multi-selector-search           MultiSelector - astryx-multi-selector-search
multi-selector-section-heading  MultiSelector - astryx-multi-selector-section-heading

Each key goes under `components` in defineTheme; it paints `.astryx-<key>`.
Props take a value (`variant:secondary`); states are written bare (`checked`).
One component in full: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <Name>
